fact: The ANINF (Agence nationale des infrastructures numériques et des fréquences) is stated to provide protection, supervision and resilience of the digital infrastructures in its perimeter, with security-event analysis, forensics, isolation and restoration support, and to have been approached by public bodies for audits and investigations in recent months.

GabonReview reports that the national digital infrastructure agency ANINF, through its Information Security Directorate, deploys the SecBOM asset-mapping tool linked to the national cybersecurity systems (SOC, CSIRT), so a national cyber function exists and operates; no creating act is cited.

fact: The ministry page says ANINF was created by Decree 212/PR of 27 January 2011 and has the mission of drawing up and running a national cybersecurity plan covering prevention, detection, incident response and recovery.
